Pull down at the very top of the **Settings** app to respring your device. A pull-to-refresh gesture, repurposed to relaunch SpringBoard.

- Adds a **pull-to-respring** control to the root Settings list
- No buttons, no menus, no extra apps
- Rootless refresh of Noah Saso's original *PullToRespring* for modern iOS

Built for iPadOS 17, rootless (palera1n).

## 2.0.1  ·  2026-06-30
- Fix: respring now works on iOS 17 (FBSSystemService + SBSRelaunchAction; the old _relaunchSpringBoardNow path was dead)
- Easier trigger: a deliberate over-pull fires it, so the Settings search bar no longer swallows the gesture

## 2.0.0  ·  2026-06-30
- Rootless (arm64, /var/jb) rewrite for iOS 17
- Modern UIRefreshControl on the Settings root list
- Credit: original PullToRespring by Noah Saso (MIT)
